outcome: Women's Perceived Spousal Support Scale scores
cohort: 80 mothers registered with a Pediatric Adolescent Women and Reproductive Health Center
finding: Mothers who received more support from their spouses during the postpartum period had higher breastfeeding rates.
mod_finding: This study found that mothers who had cesarean deliveries had higher rates of exclusive breastfeeding if they received more support from their spouses during the postpartum period.
